scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cre/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cre/shared && npm run dev -w @cre/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cre/shared && npm run build -w @cre/api && npm run build -w @cre/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cre/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts README.md
